title: Rule #1: Demand the Math (Anti-Fluff Gate)
rules: Reject vanity metrics (follower counts, impressions, code lines).
Demand core economics: CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), LTV (Lifetime Value), Monthly Churn %, Gross Margin %.
If LTV:CAC is under 3:1, the business is bleeding. If churn is over 5%/month, acquisition is pouring water into a leaky bucket.
